name: cannavec-science
description: Elite-tier cannabis-science plugin for the working researcher (v0.3 routing-and-surfacing release). Five commands; eight curated science registries with freshness watch and cannabinoid-scoped filtering (major + minor cannabinoids incl. Δ⁸-THC/HHC/THCO/THCP, terpenes, drug interactions, adverse events, populations, contraindications, pharmacogenomics); seven phytochemistry rigor detectors (isomer-collapse, receptor-without-ID, dose-without-route, THCA-vs-THC conflation, matrix-unit confusion, decarb-context-missing, entourage-overclaim) with (detector, span) deduplication; 15 banned-pattern detector; safety preflight; span-aware named-cannabinoid resolution (Δ⁸-THC no longer fires the Δ⁹-THC monograph); topical-relevance grade aggregation (no Level A laundering on entourage-effect prompts); cannabis-noun → cannabinoid-set expansion for partner-drug matching; endocannabinoidome (eCBome) registry threaded into compose_answer; identifier verification across all five Constitution §I shapes (PMID, DOI, NCT, ChEMBL, UniProt); registry inventory subcommand; honest 0-claim classification; retraction enforcement at composition time; live discovery across eleven primary-source databases — PubMed, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubChem, PharmGKB, RCSB PDB, Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, BindingDB, bioRxiv, medRxiv — with deterministic cross-source synthesis and citation-network forward-pushback analysis; researcher-workflow scaffolders (PICO, sample-size / power calculation, GRADE evidence-profile table, IRB protocol skeleton); regulatory-feasibility advisory (US / EU / Canada / UK); BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography export with inline GRADE annotation; registry-freshness probe. Researcher audience only. Stdlib-only Python ≥ 3.9.
